messages:
deploybot: PROD deploy started for release v3.6.0 (tag: v3.6.0, commit: 9f2a7b). Initiating canary (5%) in us-west-2. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.in/releases/v3.6.0 :rocket:
maria: copying notes here — no DB migrations, config pin `feature.flip_timeout=60s`. I will own smoke checks and perf for the next 30m.
sam: oncall acked. watching latency and error-rate dashboards.
alex: cache invalidation script queued (`infra/tools/purge_cache --env prod --prefix /models/kv`). will run after canary ok.
deploybot: canary finished: all healthchecks passed (latency P95 120ms, errors 0.2%). shifting to 25% traffic.
maria: running smoke suite: chat generation, embeddings, and streaming flows. small spike on streaming for a single node, investigating.
sam: flagged a transient 5xx spike in us-west-2-az-b at +12m, looks like backpressure on one host; not widespread. recommending hold for 3m to confirm.
maria: holding rollout, paused traffic shift. live logs: ```ERR conn_pool_overflow: host-id=usw2-b node=10.8.4.21``` Restarted process on that host, cordon done.
alex: host rebooted, healthchecks clearing. rebalanced KV cache.
deploybot: hold cleared. resuming rollout to 100% over next 6m.
deploybot: PROD deploy complete for v3.6.0 (commit 9f2a7b). Cutover time 00:18 (canary->full). No rollback required. Tags pinned: `prod:v3.6.0` and `commit:9f2a7b`.
maria: verified smoke + basic evals passed. promoting tag and updating rollout notes. :white_check_mark:
sam: closing watch window, will keep 1h post-cutover follow-up alerting on. ping me if any regressions.
release-bot: Release summary posted: https://redwood.in/releases/v3.6.0/summary — includes rollback instructions and postmortem playbook.
deploybot: If any team needs a rollback, post `rollback request` in #eng-releases and include `commit` or `tag`. Logs and telemetry retained for 30d. :lock:
